data.explanation:
Kotmale Holdings PLC continues to experience financial weakness, reporting a net loss of 3.525 million alongside negative operating cash flows in the most recent financial year. The company has faced ongoing profitability challenges and has consistently maintained a policy of withholding cash distributions, having paid no dividends to shareholders since 2016.

Key risks include persistent negative cash flows, ongoing net losses, and broader macroeconomic headwinds such as elevated inflation and economic volatility. Because the company is not currently distributing any dividends, a dividend cut in the upcoming financial year is impossible, and payouts are expected to remain at zero.
